title: Lucky Charm Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Lucky Charm is a 2 BR / 2 BA / 7 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. his exceptional cottage blends beachside living with traditional southern charisma and appeal, a home that’s just as inviting to visitors as it is to vacation guests.
description_expanded: Description138 WEST RUSKIN PLACE2 QUEENS, 2 TWINS IN LOFT. (Twins loft accommodate smaller children)A Quintessential Seaside Retreat with Southern CharmWith five inviting porches and undeniable curb appeal, Lucky Charm is a classic Seaside, Florida vacation rental that lives up to its name. This cheerful cottage blends traditional Southern charm with relaxed beachside living, creating a welcoming retreat for families and friends. Surrounded by lush, tropical landscaping, the brightly colored exterior hints at the warmth within, while the interior reveals a surprisingly modern and airy design.Bright, Modern Living SpacesStep inside to a light-filled main living area featuring high ceilings, crisp white walls, and soft, coastal-inspired furnishings. The open layout flows effortlessly into a dedicated dining area and a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances and white cabinetry—perfect for preparing meals after a day at the beach or gathering for relaxed family dinners.Comfortable Bedrooms & Thoughtful LayoutThe first floor includes a queen bedroom and a full bathroom, conveniently located just off the main living space. The bedroom opens directly to the outdoors, offering an easy transition between indoor and porch living.Upstairs on the second floor, guests will find a cozy sitting nook ideal for reading or unwinding. A second queen bedroom is paired with an adjacent bathroom featuring a walk-in shower. For added convenience, a stacked washer and dryer are tucked neatly into this bathroom.A stairway continues to the third-floor enclosed bonus loft, outfitted with two twin beds—perfect for younger guests. From the loft, step out onto the upper deck and enjoy sweeping rooftop views of Seaside, complete with ample seating for relaxing or entertaining.Outdoor Living & Porches GaloreOne of Lucky Charm’s standout features is its abundance of outdoor living space. From the backyard to multiple porches and the rooftop deck, guests can dine al fresco, sip morning coffee, or unwind in the coastal breeze at any time of day.Unbeatable Seaside LocationTucked away in a quiet and peaceful setting, this Seaside vacation home is located directly across from The Chapel at Seaside and just minutes from the heart of Seaside Town Center. Enjoy easy access to boutique shopping, renowned restaurants, and the iconic white-sand beaches of the Gulf—all while staying in one of Seaside’s most charming cottages.Lucky Charm offers the perfect balance of comfort, character, and location for an unforgettable Seaside, Florida getaway.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter.FEATURES 1,252 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceSeaside Residential Beach access at West Ruskin PavilionApprox. 352 yards / 5-minute walk to the white-sand beaches of SeasidePrime location near The Chapel at SeasideEnclosed porch for relaxed indoor–outdoor livingSpacious yard surrounded by lush landscapingPeacock Alley linens throughout the home, featuring fresh, luxurious towels and sheetsAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerPersonalized service provided throughout your stayWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes, available for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityStarter amenities provided for a seamless arrivalTwo parking passes included for two-bedroom and larger homes (golf carts are considered vehicles; golf carts for non-homeowners are prohibited—special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit)No pets permittedSTR23-002241
